died.name: Vitellius
died.cause: prior to his killing on the Gemonian stairs
died.last_words: And yet I was once our emperor.

died.name: Hugh Mackail
died.last_words: And now I begin my intercourse with God, which shall never be broken off. Farewell, father and mother, friends and relations; farewell, the world and all delights; farewell, sun, moon and stars! Welcome, God and Father; welcome, sweet Jesus Christ, the mediator of the new covenant; welcome, blessed Spirit of grace, the God of all consolation; welcome, glory; welcome, eternal life; and welcome, death.

died.name: George Eliot
died.last_words: Tell them I have a great pain in my left side.

died.name: Dwight L. Moody
died.last_words: I see earth receding; Heaven is opening; God is calling me.

born.name: John Crome

born.name: Ann Hasseltine Judson
